reason: The user requested action after the effectiveness review: concentrate on reader problems and adjust investment using observed results. Publication continues; production volume is not an outcome metric.
primaryAudience: People choosing and using AI browsers
Developers connecting browser agents to an existing authorized browser session
priorityIntents: Existing-browser MCP connection mode, profile selection and connection errors
AI-browser task and product selection with verified capability boundaries
Browser-agent development problems with a complete configuration, diagnostic path or reproducible example
deprioritize: Generic lifestyle workflows without direct evidence of demand from the core audience
Synonym pages for questions already answered by an existing intent owner
Broad Playwright API coverage without a clear browser-agent reader task

dailyPublication.target: Approximately five complete independent new themes per day; English and Chinese editions count once. Substantial existing-page improvements are reported separately.
dailyPublication.qualityRule: Do not manufacture independent themes or publish outlines to fill the target. Check existing ownership, audience fit, current demand evidence and a specific information gain before writing.
dailyPublication.completedCycles: Never repeat a completed batch. Additional authorized work uses the next sequential batch after verified predecessor completion.
dailyPublication.newTopicMix: Prefer a majority of new themes about core AI-browser use and task-based tool selection. Developer integration is a supporting track selected from concrete reader questions; do not fill the schedule with generic API-reference coverage or weak topics to meet a mix.

required: A concrete reader question and useful next action
Current public demand evidence or dated private Search Console query evidence, with limitations
Direct inspection of relevant competing pages and current primary technical sources
An explicit improvement over the existing answer
insufficientAlone: A long article or a fixed word count
An official API reference with no additional reader value
selectionGate.competitorAnalysis: Separate observed page features, hypotheses and unknowns. Never assign causal ranking percentages or invent backlinks, traffic, keyword volume or difficulty.

immediateExistingOwners.action: Improve documented connection-error diagnosis, mode choice and safe endpoint verification; preserve the dated local execution evidence and its limits.
Improve the extension/CDP decision path, profile selection and failed-connection checks using current official instructions.
Next candidate for a source-backed task-selection review; make changes only where an actual gap is found. Not part of this two-owner refresh.

contentContract.answer: Start with a useful direct answer; do not force every answer into a 50-character template.
contentContract.body: Use the structure the task requires: decision table, prerequisites, configuration, expected observations and concrete errors. Include current sources and relevant internal next steps.
contentContract.evidence: Clearly separate official documentation, actual local execution and proposed untested procedures. Never invent firsthand experience.
contentContract.schema: Use structured data only where accurate and appropriate. FAQ content may help readers; schema coverage is not a ranking or AI-citation guarantee.
contentContract.editing: Apply humanizer and humanizer-zh without losing code, versions, qualifications or facts; independent review remains required.

measurement.windows: Compare matching closed and actually available 7/14/28-day page, query and language windows. Record refresh time separately from first publication time.
diagnosticStates: Index status or reporting unavailable: unknown
Not indexed: investigate the individual page; do not treat missing performance rows as proof
Impressions without clicks: inspect query fit, position, title and competing results
Clicks without known downstream actions: conversion outcome unknown
measurement.aiVisibility: Record engine, date, prompt, citation URL and sample size when actually observed. A single answer is not a stable citation rate, and standard Google clicks are not proof of AI referrals.
measurement.weeklyReview: Monday in the existing task; next scheduled review 2026-11-09. Explicit user requests may trigger earlier review.
measurement.success: Qualified search clicks and verified useful downstream actions; publication counts, crawlers, request totals and skill counts are not substitutes.
measurement.sevenDays: A review checkpoint, not a promise of top-three rankings or AI recommendations.

operationalBoundaries: Reviewed content is published through the existing durable project graph with CI and dual-domain verification
No index or sitemap submissions; analytics and indexing observations remain read-only
No detection website, EasyBR client/backend changes, unsolicited outreach or new paid subscriptions
Raw account data and measured performance remain private
A plan or a successful deployment does not establish traffic uplift
